title: ACP core objects (2026-04-17)
caption: The checkout session holds capabilities with payment handlers, line items, totals and, after completion, an order. The complete request's payment_data points to a handler and carries a vault token that the allowance binds to one session and one merchant. Fields are a subset of the 2026-04-17 JSON Schema.
alt: Class diagram. CheckoutSession has id, status, currency, capabilities, line_items, fulfillment_options, totals, messages, links and order. Capabilities has payment, interventions and extensions; payment lists PaymentHandler objects with id, name, version, requires_delegate_payment, requires_pci_compliance, psp and config. LineItem has id, item, quantity and totals; Item has id, name and unit_amount. Total has type, display_text and amount. PaymentData references a handler by handler_id and carries a token from DelegatePaymentResponse (id, created, metadata), which an Allowance (reason, max_amount, currency, checkout_session_id, merchant_id, expires_at) binds to a checkout session. Order has id, checkout_session_id, permalink_url, status and adjustments.
